description_en: Modifies the cleanup configuration for offline hosts. Only non-Alibaba Cloud hosts are supported
description_zh: 修改离线主机清理配置，仅支持云外主机
kebab_example: aliyun sas modify-asset-clean-config --asset-clean-configs Status=1 CleanDays=7 Type=1 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAssetCleanConfig

fields.help_en: The number of offline days after which non-Alibaba Cloud hosts are automatically cleaned up. Valid values: integers from 1 to 30
fields.help_zh: 云外主机自动清理的离线天数，取值：1~30的整数
fields.name: clean_days

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic cleanup of offline non-Alibaba Cloud hosts. Valid values:

0: Disabled.
1: Enabled
fields.help_zh:
是否开启离线云外主机自动清理。取值：

0：否
1：是
fields.name: status

fields.help_en:
The type of host to clean up. Valid values:

1: non-Alibaba Cloud host
fields.help_zh:
清理的主机类型，取值：

· 1：云外主机
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The list of asset cleanup configurations
parameters.help_zh: 资产清理配置的列表信息
parameters.name: asset_clean_configs

Data.description_en:
The processing result. Valid values:
true: Succeeded.
false: Failed
Data.description_zh:
处理结果。取值：
true：成功
false：失败

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
